title: 新增 NowledgeMemSource 实体和 Source 管理方法
action: 新增 NowledgeMemSource 类型定义和 INowledgeMemService 中 addSource/listSources/getSource/deleteSource/ingestSource 方法，在 NowledgeMemAdapter 中实现
steps: 1. 在 protocols/nowledge-mem.ts 新增 NowledgeMemSource 类型: { id: string, type: 'file'|'url'|'reference', name: string, path?: string, url?: string, content?: string, labels?: string[], ingestedAt?: string, memoryIds?: string[] }
- addSource(pathOrUrl: string, options?: { type?: 'file'|'url'|'reference', labels?: string[] }): Promise<NowledgeMemSource>
- listSources(options?: { type?: string, limit?: number }): Promise<NowledgeMemSource[]>
- ingestSource(id: string, options?: { dryRun?: boolean }): Promise<{ memoryIds: string[], extractedEntities: number }>
- searchSourceChunks(sourceId: string, query: string, options?: { limit?: number }): Promise<Array<{ content: string, score: number }>>
3. 在 NowledgeMemAdapter 中实现每个方法，映射到 CLI: sources add/list/show/delete/ingest/search-chunks
4. 新增测试覆盖 Source CRUD + ingest + search-chunks
test_criteria: adapter 正确映射到 CLI sources 命令
5+ 个新测试覆盖 Source 生命周期
